rca of the issue: Fix RCA: The iter112 blocker was that react-native-web's DOM FormData.append(name, value) stringifies non-Blob values via String(value), so the RN-only {uri,name,type} object became the literal string '[object Object]' on the wire, and FastAPI's UploadFile parser rejected it with a 422 value_error. The applied fix in /app/mobile/src/api/client.ts:171-184 wraps the file part in a Platform.OS branch: on 'web' it does `const blob = await (await fetch(file.uri)).blob(); form.append('chunk', blob, file.name)` so a real Blob (with the correct filename param) reaches the server, and on native it keeps the original RN shape. Verification steps run: (1) login as serkan on web preview, (2) create TMP task, (3) '+ Ekle' -> 'Galeri' -> probe.png -> row renders with red thumbnail + '287 B · serkan' + EKLER (1), (4) '+ Ekle' -> 'Dosya' -> probe.txt -> second row + EKLER (2), (5) tap 'probe.png' filename -> full-screen preview opens showing red image + filename caption, (6) tap task-detail-attach-preview-close -> modal closes, (7) tap task-detail-attach-delete-<id> -> 'Dosyayı sil?' confirm modal appears, (8) tap task-detail-attach-delete-confirm -> row removed + count drops to EKLER (1). No 422, no raw JSON leak.
